images.title: Add 67 and 58
images.purpose: Show addition with place value: 10 ones regroup as 1 ten and 10 tens regroup as 1 hundred.
images.composition: A fuel display bar over a hundreds, tens and ones chart for 67 + 58 with two carry circles and the sum 125 litres, and a small fuel pump at the left.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A place value chart, 3 columns each 220 px wide, x 398 to 1058. Column header row y 70 to 140 with the names Hundreds, Tens, Ones in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (38 px), each centred in its column. The chart body is a table with 1 header row and 4 rows, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with thin construction grey #6B7280 lines (2 px) between the columns. Row 1 (carry row) y 140 to 215; row 2 (first number) y 215 to 315; row 3 (second number) y 315 to 415; a thick dark rule (6 px) at y 425 across the chart; row 4 (answer row) y 435 to 535. In the first number row (centre y 265) the digits, left to right, are: column 1 empty; 6 at x 728; 7 at x 948, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the second number row (centre y 365) the digits, left to right, are: column 1 empty; 5 at x 728; 8 at x 948, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the answer row (centre y 485) the digits, left to right, are: 1 at x 508; 2 at x 728; 5 at x 948, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). A + sign in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px) stands at x 338, y 365, to the left of the second number. In the carry row there are exactly 2 circles: a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 508, y 178 holding 1; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 728, y 178 holding 1. The circle over the Tens column holds the 1 regrouped from 10 ones, and the circle over the Hundreds column holds the 1 regrouped from 10 tens.  FUEL DISPLAY LOOK: above the chart a display bar, a rounded rectangle x 398 to 1058, y 12 to 62, filled dark #1F2937, with the words Litres of fuel in white bold sans-serif (34 px) centred in it. At the left, with no text, a flat fuel pump pictogram: a body rectangle x 60 to 200, y 170 to 520 filled amber #E69F00 and outlined dark #2B2B2B 4 px, in its upper part a display window x 85 to 175, y 195 to 275 filled white and outlined dark 3 px, a base slab x 40 to 220, y 520 to 550 filled construction grey #6B7280, and a hose, a curved dark #2B2B2B line (6 px) from the right side of the body at x 200, y 380 curving down to a small nozzle (a rectangle 40 by 24 px filled dark #2B2B2B) at x 260, y 470. Under the chart, centred at x 728, y 650, the line 67 + 58 = 125 litres in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (96 px), the largest text in the frame. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Add the ones, regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, add the tens, regroup 10 tens as 1 hundred: 67 + 58 = 125.
images.description: A fuel display with 67 above 58, the carries 1 and 1, and the sum 125 litres.
images.context: Concept image for Adding with Place Value, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Follow the ones, then the tens, then the hundreds. The slip to watch: writing 15 in the ones place.

image_decisions.why: The chart is the mathematics: the carry circles show where each regrouped 1 goes.
